title: DP776 Competition Through Fares and Fare Accesses on the Air Transport Market
title_zh: DP776 航空运输市场中的票价竞争与票价准入
authors: Fiorella Kostoris Padoa Schioppa, Martino Ajmone Marsan, Lionel Fontagné, Cristina Mitaritonna, Gianluca Orefice 等
official: 官方在线 1993-02-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper concentrates on the effects of increased competition on fare behaviour. It uses an unpublished 1990 dataset on eight fare categories adopted by Alitalia on medium-range international routes (Europe, North Africa, Middle East). Using an index of competitive pressure on Alitalia, we find that competition is stronger in the EC than elsewhere in the medium-range markets. Moreover, increases in the degree of competition cause average fares to fall, and fare variability to increase, as new lower fares are introduced, or passengers are allowed easier access to low fares which already exist. In non-EC medium-range (still regulated) markets, the determination of fares does not seem to depend on the number of carriers serving each route, as the presence of many `competitors' -- who in fact collude -- may even suggest the existence of a market where prices can actually increase.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于竞争加剧对票价行为的影响。研究采用意大利航空1990年未公开的八类票价数据集，涵盖其中程国际航线（欧洲、北非、中东）。通过构建意大利航空面临的竞争压力指数，我们发现中程市场中欧盟地区的竞争强度高于其他区域。此外，竞争程度的提升导致平均票价下降，而票价波动性增加——这源于新低价票种的引入，或乘客更易获取既有低价票种。在非欧盟中程（仍受管制）市场，票价决定似乎不取决于每条航线的承运商数量，因为众多"竞争者"（实际存在合谋行为）的存在甚至可能暗示市场存在票价上涨空间。

title: Social Security Reforms, Retirement, and Sectoral Decisions
title_zh: 社会保障改革、退休与部门决策
authors: Bruno R. Delalibera, Pedro Cavalcanti Ferreira, Rafael Machado Parente
abstract: We study social security reforms in economies with segmented labor markets and pension systems. We develop a life‐cycle general equilibrium model with heterogeneous agents and endogenous retirement and sectoral choice across public, formal, and informal jobs. Calibrated to Brazil, the model shows that unifying pension systems and raising the minimum retirement age reduce the pension deficit by nearly 40 percent, while increasing output, capital accumulation, and welfare, despite redistributive effects across age groups, sectors, and along the transition path. Sectoral reallocation plays a central role in shaping reform effects, and ignoring these margins substantially underestimates the macroeconomic consequences of pension reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动力市场与养老金体系存在分割的经济体中实施社会保障改革的效果。我们构建了一个包含异质性主体、内生退休决策以及公共部门、正规部门与非正规部门间职业选择的生命周期一般均衡模型。基于巴西数据的校准结果显示：统一养老金体系并提高最低退休年龄可使养老金赤字降低近40%，同时提升产出、资本积累与社会福利水平——尽管这一过程伴随着不同年龄群体、不同部门以及转型路径上的再分配效应。部门间重新配置在塑造改革效果中发挥核心作用，若忽略这些调整维度，将显著低估养老金改革的宏观经济影响。

title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools
title_zh: AI扩散鸿沟：K-12学校中人工智能的不均衡整合
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Although use of generative AI tools has quickly become widespread in education settings, emerging evidence suggests that effects on learning will depend on how that use is supported and guided. This paper reports findings from an original national survey of K-12 school principals designed to measure institutional integration of AI in schools through policies, teacher training, guidance for student use, leadership engagement, and the availability of AI-enabled tools. We find that AI use has spread rapidly across schools, largely as a productivity aid. Students mainly use AI for homework help and writing, while educators primarily use it for lesson planning and administrative tasks. The development of teacher training, guidance, and school policies has lagged adoption. We next document two diffusion gaps across schools: First, lower AI integration is associated with a higher share of disadvantaged students (a one standard deviation increase in disadvantage is associated with a 0.07-0.11 SD lower score on an index of AI integration); Second, private and charter schools score 0.23-0.44 SD lower on the AI integration index than traditional public schools. Although several surveyed school-level factors strongly predict AI integration, they do little to explain these gaps. Differences in district size account for roughly one-third of the disadvantage gap between public schools. These findings suggest that the factors associated with greater AI integration differ from those needed to narrow disparities in how schools support and guide AI use.
abstract_zh: 尽管生成式人工智能工具在教育领域的应用已迅速普及，但新出现的证据表明，其对学习效果的影响将取决于使用方式是否得到有效支持和引导。本文基于一项针对K-12学校校长的全国性原创调查，旨在通过政策制定、教师培训、学生使用指导、领导层参与以及人工智能工具的可及性等维度，衡量学校对人工智能的制度化整合程度。研究发现，人工智能在学校中已快速普及，主要作为生产力辅助工具。学生主要将其用于作业辅助和写作，而教育工作者则主要将其用于课程规划与行政事务。然而，教师培训、使用指导及学校政策的制定却滞后于实际应用。我们进一步发现两类学校间的扩散差距：其一，人工智能整合程度较低与弱势学生比例较高相关（弱势学生比例每增加一个标准差，人工智能整合指数得分降低0.07-0.11个标准差）；其二，私立学校和特许学校的人工智能整合指数得分比传统公立学校低0.23-0.44个标准差。尽管调查中多个学校层面的因素能显著预测人工智能整合程度，但这些因素对上述差距的解释力有限。学区规模差异可解释公立学校间约三分之一的弱势差距。这些发现表明，促进人工智能整合的因素与缩小学校在支持和引导人工智能使用方面差距所需的条件并不相同。

title: Embracing carbon uncertainty in portfolio construction
title_zh: 投资组合构建中的碳不确定性考量
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a framework for constructing fixed-income portfolios of sovereign bonds that integrates financial and environmental considerations. Central to our approach is the introduction of carbon returns, a concept analogous to financial returns, modeled as random variables to capture the inherent uncertainty of future carbon emissions.

title: Trump's global tariff war: Faulty premises, costly consequences
title_zh: 特朗普的全球关税战：错误的前提，高昂的代价
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: President Donald Trump's Global Tariff War has discarded US commitments to the postwar international trading order established under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and the World Trade Organization (WTO). It replaces the Most Favored Nation (MFN) principle with an "Every Nation Different" principle under the false premise that any economy with a trade surplus against the United States must be cheating on its trade obligations and imposes a "reciprocal" tariff increase based on the ratio of bilateral US imports to exports. It fails to recognize the role of US fiscal deficits in boosting demand for imports, and of the attractiveness of the US capital market to inflows of foreign capital in strengthening the dollar and contributing to a persistent trade deficit. The Trump Global Tariff War promises revival of US manufacturing jobs under the false premise that trade deficits rather than technological change and Engel curve shifts in demand toward services have driven the decline in the share of manufacturing in employment and GDP. It shows no recognition that higher tariffs are a self-inflicted wound to the economy because of large static welfare triangle costs and loss in dynamic efficiency growth. This study estimates that the 18 percent rise in tariffs so far in the Trump Global Tariff War imposes an ongoing future static welfare cost of 0.28 percent of GDP. The medium-term dynamic efficiency loss brings the total welfare loss reaching a range of 1.1 to 2.3 percent of baseline GDP by 2035. Congressional Budget Office budget estimates of increased tariff revenues of 1 percent of GDP over the next decade (including interest savings) may be understated on an implied premise of sharp import reductions but overstated because President Trump has suggested giving them away in "tariff dividend" checks to all but high-income households. Moreover, a possible Supreme Court ruling against application of the "emergency" legislation on which the main tariff increases are based further reduces the reliability of revenue estimates. The Trump Global Tariff War has usefully revealed a vulnerability of the US economy to a future cutoff in the supply of rare earth minerals, metals, and magnets imported from China that requires urgent action.
abstract_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的全球关税战抛弃了美国在《关税与贸易总协定》（GATT）和世界贸易组织（WTO）框架下对战后国际贸易秩序的承诺。它以"每个国家都不同"原则取代最惠国待遇（MFN）原则，其错误前提是任何对美贸易顺差经济体必然违反贸易义务，并基于双边美进口与出口比率实施"对等"关税加征。该政策未能认识到美国财政赤字对进口需求的拉动作用，以及美国资本市场对外资流入的吸引力如何强化美元并导致持续贸易逆差。特朗普全球关税战承诺重振美国制造业就业，其错误前提是贸易逆差而非技术变革及恩格尔曲线向服务需求转移导致了制造业在就业与GDP中占比下降。该政策完全无视更高关税因巨大的静态福利三角形成本与动态效率增长损失而对经济造成的自伤效应。本研究估算，特朗普全球关税战迄今18%的关税加征将产生持续的未来静态福利成本，占GDP的0.28%。中期动态效率损失使总福利损失在2035年达到基准GDP的1.1%至2.3%区间。美国国会预算办公室关于未来十年关税收入增加GDP的1%（含利息节省）的预算估算，可能因隐含进口大幅减少的前提而被低估，但亦因特朗普总统提议向除高收入家庭外的所有群体发放"关税红利"支票而被高估。此外，最高法院可能裁定主要关税加征所依据的"紧急状态"立法不适用，进一步降低了收入估算的可靠性。特朗普全球关税战有效揭示了美国经济未来面临从中国进口的稀土矿物、金属及磁材供应中断的脆弱性，亟需采取紧急行动。
